dataset: UAE Insurance Ecosystem Explorer evidence log

records.claim: The CBUAE Rulebook describes broad insurance product categories and principal insurance-sector participants.
records.source_location: Section 2.1 — Overview of Insurance Sector Activities and Participants
records.notes: Check current applicability and later amendments before legal interpretation.

records.claim: The CBUAE Rulebook page for Insurance Company Licensing Regulation C 4/2026 states an effective date of 14 August 2026 and In-Force status.
records.notes: Supports the regulation page's stated status, not interpretation of every obligation.

records.claim: The 19-sector taxonomy is an exploratory navigation structure with dedicated pages, not a confirmed exhaustive official UAE insurance classification.
records.source_location: data/sectors.json and the 19 dedicated sector HTML pages
records.notes: Dedicated prototype pages show content coverage only; compare each line against applicable official classes and product definitions before making regulatory or market-completeness claims.

records.claim: The main market map in index.html defines 10 high-level nodes; the dedicated sector explorer layer and registry contain 19 sector pages/records.
records.source_location: index.html sector array; data/sectors.json; root-level sector HTML pages
records.status: verified by source-code inspection; registry aligned on audit branch
records.notes: This is a distinction between the high-level map and dedicated detail pages, not a claim about the total number of official UAE insurance classes. The registry now links each of the 19 records to an existing dedicated page.

records.claim: The CBUAE Annual Report 2025 reports AED 75.2 billion gross written premiums (+15.5% year-on-year) and AED 46.2 billion gross paid claims (+11%) for 2025.
records.source_location: Insurance Supervision — Key Financial Data / Gross Written Premiums / Paid Claims
records.status: official annual-report figures reviewed in indexed report text
records.notes: A separate statistical publication has been reported with a different premium total. Preserve the source-specific figure and reconcile definitions/tables before cross-publication comparison.

records.claim: The CBUAE register PDF titled 'CB Register September of 2026' lists numbered insurance-company entries through item 54, followed by a separate section for insurance brokers and other related professions.
records.source_location: PDF pages 1–4; insurance companies section ends at numbered item 54 and related-professions section follows
records.status: register inspected; exact current entity census should be confirmed against all pages and any subsequent register update
records.notes: Do not present the historical Q4 2025 count of 58 as the current September 2026 count. Validate full list, category labels, and any register changes before publishing an entity-count KPI.
